title: Euclid × SPT-3G 6×2pt
author: Cail Daley
description: The SPT × Euclid 6×2pt key-project paper for SPT-3G: the TR1 analysis, the covariance plan, first blinded posteriors, open problems, the SPT products needed and Euclid external-collaborator access.

sections.title: The TR1 analysis
